{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Castro regime is an anachronism in a region where democracy and open markets prevail.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current political and economic crisis in Cuba reflects four decades of Castro's failed policies.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Cuban government rightfully remains on the State Department's Terrorist List due to its continued support for terrorism, including the harboring of fugitives from justice wanted in the United States for terrorism-related offenses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Castro regime continues to pursue policies of Marxist-Leninist dictatorship, police state tactics, and total economic control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Because of these policies, the Castro regime remains hostile to America's interests and values.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for maintaining the current embargo on trade with Cuba and restrictions on travel to Cuba as long as the Cuban government refuses to hold free and fair elections, ease its stranglehold on private enterprise, and allow the Cuban people to organize, assemble, and speak freely.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans understand that the Castro regime will not change by its own choice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Cuba must change.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for providing additional resources for democracy-building activities in Cuba.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for providing additional resources for support for the family members of the political opposition.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Support for providing additional resources for support for efforts to help youth, women, and Afro-Cubans take their rightful place in the pro-democracy movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
